findings.title: `I18n.ensure_loaded!` is called on the I18n module, but the diff only defines `ensure_loaded!` on the backend
findings.description: `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!` iterates the locales and calls `I18n.ensure_loaded! l` (line 21). The only `ensure_loaded!` added in this diff is in `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb`, where it takes a locale argument and sits alongside `translate` and `load_locale`. The 4-space indentation in that hunk suggests it is an instance method on the backend class, not a module-level method on `I18n`. If so, `I18n.ensure_loaded!` raises `NoMethodError`. Because `ApplicationController` calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` on every request path that reaches line 158, this would break page rendering. The call should go through the backend (for example `I18n.backend.ensure_loaded!(l)`), or the module-level method should be defined. I could not open the full `translate_accelerator.rb` to confirm the enclosing class, so this rests on the hunk context and should be checked before merging.
